text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Fernweh. It means "a longing for distant 
places." 
A uniquely German concept, with no direct 
equivalent in Japanese.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Vague emotions such as this played no part 
in my decision to study abroad. 
Everything was to proceed strictly 
according to the original plan.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That is why it was so unexpected. 
To think that, shortly after arriving in 
Japan, I would be seized by the exact 
opposite feeling...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
(It must be morning in Germany right 
now... and still quite cool. 
The bakery just opened, so it's probably a 
busy hour...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...... 
Hey, have you shared anything rare or 
interesting you found in Japan with your 
parents yet?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Um, if you mean photos of local tourist 
spots, I have already sent them.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
You mean like racetracks and the Furlong 
Tower, right? 
You haven't shared any Japanese pop 
culture yet, have you?!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Urrrrrgh! Dywaa☆ 
When Falco makes a run for it~~?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...... Um, what on earth is this?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
It's an Umadol street live by Smart 
Falcon! 
Now, when Falco makes a run for it~~? 
(You've gotta chase after her~!)

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Photos and videos are totally fine, so 
please, please preach the gospel to your 
parents too♪ 
Maybe it'll blow up in Germany and take me 
global~?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Umadol"... I have never heard of that 
term. 
Is it a derivative of "idol"?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, it certainly seems to be a rare 
and unique aspect of Japanese culture. 
This is something... my parents surely 
haven't seen before.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
After that, I went to watch her live shows 
three times. 
And from the fourth time onward, I was no 
longer merely a spectator—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ugh, making these is so tough... Ah! 
Flash-san, 
it's already your bedtime, isn't it! I'm 
sorry, feel free to turn off the lights~!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The live performance is at 10:00 AM 
tomorrow, correct? 
It cannot be helped... I shall assist you 
for precisely 43 minutes.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh, really?! But wait, wouldn't that be a 
nuisance...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
However, I cannot sleep with the desk 
light on. 
I judge that finishing this together 
posthaste is the optimal course of action. 
Now then...!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Check it out, everyone~♪ Notice for an 
Umadol live show!♡ 
Ehehe☆ Flash-san, thank you so much for 
today too!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
*Sigh*... This is the last time, 
understand? 
—Ah, we are holding a live show. Please 
come!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Falcon-san, that is a local train! 
Unless we take the express train following 
it, we will not arrive before showtime.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that was close! Thanks♪ Flash-san, 
you're 
seriously amazing. What do you even eat to 
be this on the ball~?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm. Acoustics are good, progression is 
on schedule. 
For next week's shopping district live, we 
should change the hairstyle from 
today's...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
When Falco makes a run for it~? 
......Ehehe♪

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"—And so, the photo I just sent is of her 
new outfit... 
I sewed the ribbon for her, and she 
treated me to Hachimi in return—"

text_block_list.name: Flash's Father
text_block_list.text:
"Hahaha, what a fascinating girl. 
Flash... it seems you have found a 
Kameradin in Japan."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Eh...? No, she is simply my roommate... 
............... ......?!"

text_block_list.name: Flash's Mother
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu, regardless, we absolutely love this 
'Umadol'. 
Thanks to her, you've been contacting us 
so much more often."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Falcon-san. 
Did you... give me a reason?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's all this all of a sudden?! 
Hmmmm... Ah, could it be about having you 
help with my Umadol work?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes... but surely you already know, don't 
you? 
Your Umadol power has brought smiles to 
both me and my precious family.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Ehhh, I wasn't thinking anything that 
complicated, though~... 
If anything, Falco's the one who was 
helped out way more!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...Giggle. Then let's call it even. 
Allow me to say it once more... Thank you 
so much.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, the pleasure is all mine, Falco! 
Fufufu—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Sloppy, careless, shrewd... 
Yet sharp, kind, and always there to lend 
a hand when I was all alone in a foreign 
land.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
She's the complete opposite of me... 
Perhaps that's why we fit together like 
puzzle pieces—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
—Every single video is wonderful. 
Thank you, everyone. Great work out there.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Thank goodneeeess☆ 
We pushed through all the way until 
sunset, you know~!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
If there's anything else you need, just 
let me know, okay? 
I mean... I'm sure I can pull it off now!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Chuckle... As you can see, both of you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Looks like the plan was a success. With 
this...!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
—"Let's make this a fun festival for 
eveeeeryone~! 
Rickey☆ Lucky☆ Super Summer Vacation~☆"

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
She says "Yaaay!", but aren't there people 
here who don't have summer vacation?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My my, bless your hearts. 
For those of you with work tomorrow, how 
about I give your shoulders a good rub?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
No, no, that's not what this segment is 
about, everyone~! 
"And so, let's get this Midsummer Sand 
Beach Dirt Festival started, ya hear~☆"

text_block_list.name: Event Staff
text_block_list.text:
Alright, and cut! Great atmosphere. 
Tarumae-san really is fantastic at getting 
things back on track. It's so reassuring 
to watch!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, thank you so much!
